settings.text:
The AG-THREE Pickleball Paddle is built for The Aggressor, the player who takes initiative, speeds up the point, and dominates hands battles at the net. Engineered for aggressive play, the AG-THREE combines explosive power with a controlled, expanded sweetspot, allowing you to initiate, accelerate, and overwhelm from every swing.

At the heart of the paddle is the X3 Full Foam Core, an advanced triple foam core construction designed to enhance stability, increase the effective hitting area, and deliver a consistent, controlled power response. This innovative core structure helps absorb vibration while maintaining the solid, connected feel aggressive players rely on when attacking the ball.

Whether you're driving from the baseline, countering with speed, or pulling the trigger in fast exchanges at the kitchen line, the AG-THREE provides the power, precision, and confidence to take control of every rally and dictate the pace of the point.

settings.title: AG-THREE v1.0
settings.text: A power focused paddle designed for immediate to advanced players.

settings.title: X3 FOAM CORE
settings.text:
100% Foam. 100% Power.

  • Explosive power on drives. Dual high-energy EPP foam layers store and release energy for fast, foreful shots.
  • Soft where it matters. Enhanced dwell and touch for confident dinks, drops and resets.
  • Built to hold up. Rigid PMI core layer delivers long-lasting stability and durability.
  • Enhanced sweet spot, enhanced control. Floating core design with a dual PU foam and low density EPP foam outer rings to keep power controllable across the face.
  • Best for: Power players who still demand touch.

settings.title: THERMOFOAM FRAME
settings.text:
Enhanced Stability & Durability

  • One shot thermoformed carbon fiber panel design.
  • Epoxy resin coated laminates wrap the edge of the core.
  • Perimeter foam adds structural strength and stiffness
  • Structure enhances power and durability.

settings.title: PEEL PLY MAX
settings.text:
Enhanced Spin & Control

  • Resign-fused surface texture formed directly into the raw carbon fiber face.
  • Permanent texture remains after curing for long-lasting performance.
  • Grips the ball on contact to generate heavy, reliable spin.
  • Consistent response lets players shape shots with confidence.
  • Best for: Advanced players seeking maximum spin and precision.
